$comment: Hand names of shared helpers, keyed by kind and by the first 8 hex digits of the helper's canonical key (its default name is helper_<key>): the name its module and callers take, its parameters' names, and its documentation. tools/luau/stb2luau/transpile.py and emit.py read it.

25abe6d2.name: wait_frames
25abe6d2.doc: Waits one frame more than the given count.

d3f20302.name: wait_frames_skipping
d3f20302.doc: What skip mode runs of wait_frames: one pass of its count, without waiting.

0958ca60.name: wait_objects
0958ca60.doc: Waits until an object sequence has run its commands.

c624bc16.name: wait_camera
c624bc16.doc: Waits until the camera sequence has run its commands.

f0c5f5d1.name: wait_message
f0c5f5d1.doc: Waits while a message window opens or prints its text.

1e44cfff.name: close_message
1e44cfff.doc: Hides a message window's cursor, closes it and resets its position.

2a244c50.name: open_message
2a244c50.doc: Builds a message window's text and places it; returns what MesMake returns.

5083849a.name: message_step
5083849a.doc: Runs one frame of a message window: its mouth animation and its answer; returns 0 until the window gives a result.

b01b1877.name: wait_message_answer
b01b1877.doc: Waits for a message window's answer; returns the frames it waited and whether the expected answer was chosen.

f3f369bc.name: show_message
f3f369bc.doc: Opens a message window, waits for it to be read and closes it.

1e1681bf.name: interpolate
1e1681bf.doc: The value step steps of the given count along from from to to.

8433e29e.name: negate
8433e29e.doc: The value with its sign flipped.
